378:t_014:0.en:
$$ミカ$$
「The robot army has been wiped out!」

378:t_014:2.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Those things are mere puppets. Now feel the power of my army of darkness firsthand!」

378:t_014:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s machines are here too!」

378:t_014:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「Do you know something, $$グーラ$$!?」

378:t_014:6.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...We'll talk later. First, we crush them!」

378:t_014:7.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「You fool, Demon Beast Prince! You harbor the power of darkness, yet you dare challenge me!」

378:t_014:8.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I... will live by my own will...!」

378:t_014:10.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Heh... He's really learned to speak his mind.」

378:t_014:11.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, intercept the army of darkness.」

378:t_014:12.en:
$$葵$$
「Roger! This time, we'll finish off those things that crawled back from the depths of hell!」

378:t_014:15.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$! Don't think you can do whatever you want with this Earth or this galaxy!」

378:t_015:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$! We've defeated your entire army!」

378:t_015:1.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Today's battle was only a greeting, $$マーズ$$. Don't think this is the full extent of my power.」

378:t_015:3.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「The powers of darkness are gathering! If you usher in an age of the sun, we will usher in an age of darkness!」

378:t_015:4.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Remember this! We will fight the True War and save this universe!」

378:t_016:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...There's probably no point in pursuing them.」

378:t_016:1.en:
$$桂$$
「They'll come to us again anyway. Even though we'd rather never see them.」

378:t_016:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
「You were right, $$正太郎$$. Father... $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ is alive.」

378:t_016:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So it wasn't just $$皇帝ズール$$. That thing survived too.」

378:t_016:8.en:
$$グーラ$$
「It is just as $$ズール$$'s avatar said. The powers of darkness are gathering in this world.」

378:t_016:9.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Probably because the universe's true collapse, which happens once every 120 million years, is approaching.」

378:t_016:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But we can prevent that by defeating $$バアル$$, can't we!?」

378:t_016:11.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...Father said... that apart from the battle between gods and devils, there is a battle that will decide this universe's fate...」

378:t_016:12.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I traveled across the galaxy to investigate it.」

378:t_016:15.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...To get that answer, I'll probably have to make contact with beings like Father and $$皇帝ズール$$.」

378:t_016:18.en:
$$グーラ$$
「If I learn anything, I'll let you know too.」

378:t_016:19.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We'll see each other again, right?」

378:t_016:20.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...I don't know... $$皇帝ズール$$ and Father probably won't forgive me for defying them.」

378:t_016:21.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then come with us! It'll be safer!」

378:t_016:22.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...I still haven't atoned for what I've done...」

378:t_017:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「He's the perfect friend for $$正太郎$$.」

378:t_017:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't worry, $$ワッ太$$. You're a good friend to $$正太郎$$ in your own way too.」

378:t_017:6.en:
$$タケル$$
($$ズール$$ and $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ were still alive...)

378:t_017:7.en:
$$タケル$$
(That cold, dark darkness I felt... Was it their dark power...?)

378:t_018:0.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「...It's no good... $$鉄人$$ is going to explode...」

378:t_019:0.en:
$$カイエン$$
「All right...! We destroyed it in one hit!」

378:t_019:1.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「That was a full-power blow from $c. Something like this is easy!」

378:t_020:0.en:
$$カイエン$$
「We couldn't finish it in one blow!」

378:t_020:1.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「We have to hurry! Stop dawdling. We'll finish it with the next one!」

378:t_021:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You did well too, $$グーラ$$.」

378:t_021:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Those two make a pretty good team.」

378:t_021:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Of course they do. They're friends.」

378:t_021:4.en:
$$グーラ$$
(Friends... I want to live alongside $$正太郎$$ and the others, who taught me this warm feeling...)

378:t_021:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
(But to do that, I have to atone for what I've done in the past.)

378:t_100:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ is my dear friend! I'll never forgive you for trying to turn it into a devil!」

378:t_100:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do this, $$鉄人$$! We'll use our power to defeat the bad guys!」

378:t_101:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$! No matter how often you return to life, we will never give in to your darkness!」

378:t_101:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「I hold the promise I made with my brother in my heart! As long as I have it, I'll keep fighting with hope!」

378:t_102:0.en:
$$グーラ$$
(The powers of darkness gathering together...)

378:t_102:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
(Is everything moving toward the end...?)
